name: The Westin Resort, Costa Navarino
insider_take: This isn't just a beach resort—it's Greece's first sustainable luxury destination where ancient olive groves meet championship golf and pristine Mediterranean coastline.
whats_special: The Westin sits within a 4,500-acre eco-paradise featuring two signature golf courses designed by Bernhard Langer and Robert Trent Jones Jr. The resort preserves over 300,000 olive trees, some centuries old, while the nearby Palace of Nestor archaeological site connects you to Homer's Odyssey—this is literally the land of the legendary King Nestor.
pro_tip: Book a sunset horseback ride through the olive groves to Voidokilia Beach—it's considered one of Greece's most beautiful beaches and perfectly shaped like the Greek letter omega (?).
dont_miss: The Anazoe Spa's thalassotherapy treatments using mineral-rich seawater, and a day trip to nearby Pylos—a charming harbor town where the Battle of Navarino took place in 1827. The resort's beehives produce exclusive Costa Navarino honey, available only here.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Mediterranean coastline
World-class golf courses designed by renowned architects
Exceptional spa facilities with signature Westin wellness programs
Luxurious accommodations with authentic Greek design elements
cons: Remote location requires planned transportation for off-resort activities
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and exclusive amenities
